title: hieracium racemosum subsp. insulare
intro: Hieracium racemosum subsp. insulare, commonly known as the mountain hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The mountain hawkweed has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of infections. Its therapeutic actions include stimulating blood circulation, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic, making it useful for treating conditions like arthritis and kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium racemosum subsp. insulare include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have potential antioxidant and anti-cancer activities.
